children: Venezuela's acting president Delcy Rodriguez said on Tuesday that month-on-month inflation reached 6.2% in October, and that the country expects to receive $17 billion in financing for the public and private sectors over the next five years.
She noted that 80 contracts have been signed under a new hydrocarbons law.
